repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-llm
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin that manages LLM data-channel connections for meetings. It registers webex.internal.llm, a Mercury subclass that registers each session with the data-channel service over HTTP, connects the returned WebSocket through Mercury, and keeps per-session URLs, binding, owner meeting, and token-refresh handler, plus a session-keyed data-channel token cache guarded by owner-meeting checks.

public_interfaces.audience: plugin-meetings and internal-plugin-voicea in the webex-js-sdk workspace
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package also registers LLMChannel as internal plugin 'llm' with config.llm. No onBeforeLogout hook is registered.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.llm runtime methods and events
public_interfaces.audience: plugin-meetings meeting, webinar, and data-channel auth-token interceptor

negative_guidance.rule: Do not store data-channel tokens in the connections map.
negative_guidance.why: Tokens must survive disconnects; the separate datachannelTokens record exists for that.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log or put a data-channel token in a URL.
negative_guidance.why: The token is meant to travel only in the registration request header.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not skip resolveSessionOwnership on a write a non-owner must not make.
negative_guidance.why: Several meeting objects share one plugin instance.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not reimplement socket lifecycle, retries, or event emission here.
negative_guidance.why: They are inherited from Mercury and shared with every Mercury-based plugin.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the list of methods or config keys.
negative_guidance.why: It omits ownership checks, clearDatachannelToken, timing results, and config defaults. See docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: The developer confirmed no coverage gate applies; the legacy Jest config disables coverage collection.

high.expectation: Source and unit test evidence both support the change, and the behavior has a case in test/unit/spec/llm.js.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, for example clearDatachannelToken, refused-owner paths, token persistence across disconnect, or config defaults. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question. Stop and report the gap.
